item.title: Trump to eulogize Lindsey Graham at funeral in Washington today
item.description: President Trump is delivering a eulogy for Sen. Lindsey Graham, his one-time opponent for the presidency and later, his close ally.

item.title: Strong 7.1 magnitude earthquake strikes southern Japan
item.description: A powerful 7.1-magnitude earthquake hit southern Japan, disrupting transport but causing no major damage.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will "go back to doing what we were doing" if Iran talks stall
item.description: The U.S. and Iran hold fire amid work on a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but the Trump administration says a military buildup continues.

item.title: Johnson & Johnson offers $5.5 billion to settle talc lawsuits
item.description: Johnson & Johnson has offered $5.5 billion to settle tens of thousands of lawsuits claiming its baby powder and other talcum powder products caused ovarian cancer, the company says.

item.title: Suspect among 3 killed in Seattle shooting; teen arrested, 3rd suspect sought
item.description: Police believe a suspect in the deadly shooting at a food festival in Seattle was among those who were killed, as another suspect remains on the loose and a teenager is in custody.

item.title: In Michigan Senate Democratic debate, Stevens and El-Sayed spar over outside spending
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed and Rep. Haley Stevens clashed on outside spending and electability in their last debate before Michigan's Democratic primary next week.

item.title: Fauci diaries, released by Sen. Paul, touch on COVID origins, Trump
item.description: Republican Sen. Rand Paul released more than a thousand pages of journal entries from Dr. Anthony Fauci, teeing up what is likely to be a contentious hearing on Wednesday.

item.title: Ohio's GOP governor calls Trump's plans to deport Haitians a "mistake"
item.description: Republican Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine told CBS News the Trump administration's plan to ramp up deportations of Haitian migrants is a "mistake," arguing the move could bruise Ohio's economy.

item.title: Extended interview: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine on Trump's plan to deport Haitians
item.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine, a Republican, tells CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez that President Trump is making a mistake with his plan to ramp up arrests and deportations of Haitian migrants. "Haiti is hell today," DeWine says, "So you'd be sending people … back to hell."

item.title: Lindsay Clancy now on trial in murder of her 3 children in Massachusetts
item.description: Lindsay Clancy, accused of killing her three young children in her Duxbury, Massachusetts, home, is standing trial after opening statements were given Monday and testimony began.

item.title: Trump's "Freedom 250" project funding faces scrutiny under proposed bill
item.description: An attempt by House Republicans to crack down on hard-to-trace fundraising methods used by left-leaning organizations could force President Trump's "Freedoom 250" project to disclose more information about its finances. CBS News' Gabe Kaminsky reports.

item.title: Biden tapes released after legal battle, with references to classified material
item.description: Audio recordings that former President Joe Biden fought for years to keep private have now been released.

item.title: Early details on what's in the Joe Biden tapes that were just released after legal battle
item.description: Audio recordings of former President Joe Biden's interviews with his ghostwriter, which Biden fought to keep sealed, were released Monday. CBS News investigative reporter Josh Boswell reports on what they reveal.

item.title: Trump downplays concerns about defense stockpiles
item.description: President Trump is downplaying concerns about dwindling defense stockpiles after months of on-and-off fighting with Iran. Bradley Bowman, senior director of the Foundation for Defense of Democracies' Center on Military and Political Power, joins with analysis.

item.title: Legal analyst on whether Bryan Kohberger can take back guilty plea in University of Idaho murders
item.description: Bryan Kohberger is claiming he was misled when he pleaded guilty to the 2022 murders of four Idaho college students. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks down the latest development in the case.

item.title: "The Odyssey" movie sparking renewed interest in original book
item.description: Moviegoers are turning out in droves for the IMAX spectacle "The Odyssey," but they're also flocking to something else: the 2,700-year-old source material. Matt Gutman has more.

item.title: Search continues for American mom missing in Grenada
item.description: On the Caribbean island of Grenada there is an increasingly desperate search for Elizabeth Waddell, a 44-year old North Carolina mom who's been missing for five days. Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: U.S. mom and kids trapped by French wildfire: "Such an unstable situation"
item.description: A mother from Tennessee slept through wildfire evacuation operations in southwest France, and now she's trapped with her kids as the blaze threatens the city Bordeaux.

item.title: Biden recordings with ghostwriter released over his objections
item.description: Roughly 70 hours of recordings of an interview former President Joe Biden did with a ghostwriter in 2017, before he was president, were released Monday over Biden's objections. Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: European wildfires could burn for months, officials say, as evacuations continue
item.description: Deadly wildfires continue to rampage across parts of Spain and France, stranding tourists and forcing hundreds of thousands to evacuate. Officials say the fires could continue to burn for months. Imtiaz Tyab reports.

item.title: Entries from Dr. Anthony Fauci's diary released
item.description: Diary entries by Dr. Anthony Fauci are shedding light on his soaring notoriety during the COVID-19 epidemic. The documents, released by Republican Sen. Rand Paul, include Fauci's reflections about being invited to A-list parties, but also some uncertainty about the origin of COVID.

item.title: The biggest weather risk for homeowners? It's no longer hurricanes.
item.description: Severe "convective" storms account for roughly a third of global natural disaster economic losses, a new study finds.

item.title: Ex-husband testifies in trial for mom accused of murdering her kids
item.description: The trial for Lindsay Clancy, the woman accused of murdering her three small children, began Monday with her ex-husband taking the stand. Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Ohio governor calls Trump's plan to deport Haitians "a mistake"
item.description: Camilo Montoya-Galvez sits down with Ohio Governor Mike DeWine to discuss the Trump administration's plan to arrest and deport thousands of Haitians residing in the U.S. under temporary protected status.

item.title: Trump threatens more strikes on Iran if new talks stall
item.description: President Trump threatened to resume strikes on Iran if his current attempt at diplomacy fails, despite some concerns within the administration over the United States' declining military stockpile. Eleanor Watson reports.

item.title: Trump visits Michigan in pre-midterm push
item.description: President Trump visited the battleground state of Michigan on Monday with less than 100 days to go till the midterm elections. Olivia Rinaldi reports.

item.title: 7/27: CBS Evening News
item.description: Dangerous tornado tears through Wisconsin; lifeguards save young swimmer from rip current in California.

item.title: 7/27: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: New CBS News polling has Trump underwater on Iran; ICE to ramp up deportations of Haitian migrants, sources say.

item.title: Amazon plans to deploy more than 5,000 satellites for new telecom service
item.description: Amazon Leo wants to launch a constellation of thousands of satellites to connect devices directly from space.

item.title: GOP targeted progressive dark money. That could boomerang on Trump.
item.description: The Trump-linked group Freedom 250 staged America's birthday with tens of millions that it is not required to disclose.
